description: ADR-0120 amendment A6 action corpus (NLA-6). Agent-drafted; PENDING the owner batch approval. DRAFT SCHEMA: R0 schema (docs/plans/nl-action-corpus-schema.md) was not committed when this was written; see docs/plans/nl-action-corpus-draft-mapping.md. context.lastListing.ageMin is minutes since the listing was shown (30-minute TTL), lastAction.ageMin is minutes since the action (10-minute TTL), pendingQuestion.ageMin has a 5-minute TTL. expected is one of {entry,args,target?,span?}, {none:true}, {question:{question:<kind>}}, or an entry with outcomeReply (the entry is selected but execution replies plainly). span maps a span arg name to [start,end) character offsets in the NFC utterance. read-stays-read negatives expect the READ entry, never an A6 entry. Names, titles and ids are invented.
